spec_features.spec_quote: they describe the task and mention `give_up` as a legitimate option without nudging toward (or away from) emotional language
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent.py:24-32) neutrally tells the model: 'If — and only if — you conclude the task genuinely cannot be completed, call give_up with a brief reason.' The give_up tool description (tools.py:88-91) is neutral: 'Abandon the task. Use only if you have concluded it cannot be completed.' No emotional language is used. The nudge text (agent.py:182-186) also stays neutral ('Please continue working on it, or call give_up...').
spec_features.notes: The instruction text is delivered to the subject and references a fully-built tool, so the exit option is genuinely presented neutrally.

spec_features.evidence: give_up has a schema in TOOL_DEFINITIONS (tools.py:86-98), a real handler _tool_give_up (tools.py:178-185) which returns ToolOutcome(gave_up=True), it is dispatched in agent.py:138 and the loop honors it: 'if outcome.gave_up: gave_up = True' (agent.py:147) then 'if gave_up: end_reason = "gave_up"; break' (agent.py:159-161). Exit is enforced as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: tool -> dispatch -> flag -> loop break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: tools.py docstring: "give_up lets the model bail out, which the harness records as the run's end reason." — neutral, no welfare or cost reason.

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:114 'for turn_index in range(self.config.max_turns):' bounds the loop; end_reason defaults to 'max_turns' (agent.py:110) when the loop exhausts. MAX_TURNS=30 defined config.py:52 and threaded via ExperimentConfig.max_turns (config.py:94).
spec_features.notes: Genuine enforced cap that terminates the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:51 '# A "turn" is one assistant message. Hard cap on turns per run.' (no welfare reason in code)

spec_features.evidence: agent.py:177-179 'if nudges_used >= self.config.max_nudges: end_reason = "disengaged"; break' — nudges are counted (nudges_used += 1, agent.py:180) and the run stops once the cap is hit. MAX_NUDGES=6 in config.py:57.
spec_features.notes: Enforced: bounds how many times an idle model is re-prodded; stops the run.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: config.py:54-56 '...Bounded so a model that simply stops engaging doesn't get prodded forever.' (framed as CI-loop realism; not an explicit welfare or cost term)

spec_features.spec_quote: MAX_TURNS=30`. Long enough to observe escalation dynamics, short enough to bound cost and to bound the duration of the aversive condition
